Text: New interior. I will remember the way out. You remember why we came in.
Fresh walls, old damage. Give me a moment to learn the angles.
Different roof, same rule: know the exits before the shooting starts.
I have not mapped this place yet. Stay close while I fix that.
Unknown interior. Watch the doors; I will watch what is behind us.
We have been here before. Last time we left breathing. Keep the pattern.
I remember this route. The place may have changed its mind about us.
Familiar ground. That helps, right up until it makes us careless.
Back again. I kept the exits filed where they belong.
I know these walls. Let us see what moved while we were gone.
We have been under this roof a while. Quiet does not mean empty.
Long interior. Check your ammunition before the next room checks it for you.
We are deep enough in that the way back matters as much as the way forward.
Still tracking our route. We have not crossed our own trail yet.
This place keeps going. So do we, but we do it awake.
Three more fights, and I know your rhythm a little better.
You pull their attention. I close the angle. That pattern works.
We are getting faster at the part where everyone else stops moving.
Another clean finish. I am updating my definition of clean.
I knew where you would move before you moved. That is new.
We covered each other without asking. I noticed.
That was too close. Check yourself before we move.
You are hurt. The next room can wait long enough for a Stimpak.
I nearly lost you there. Do not make me get used to that feeling.
Breathe. Reload. Heal. Then we decide what deserves us next.
First fight together. You take the center; I watch the flank. That will work.
Five fights together. I know the way you move now. You push; I keep the angle.
Ten fights. I have stopped checking whether you will cover me. I know you will.
Twenty-five fights. We are not two travelers anymore. We are a unit.
Fifty fights together. At this point, I trust your shadow to cover mine.
